title: Laravel Read Replicas: Check if a Replica Has Caught Up
content:
Laravel 13.40 adds commit IDs to MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL connections, so you can check whether a read replica has a write before you read from it.

The post Laravel Read Replicas: Check if a Replica Has Caught Up appeared first on Laravel News.
